title: Snap drawings to price bars
content:
You can snap drawings to the nearest OHLC price values on the bars by enabling "Magnet Mode".
To temporarily enable the magnet feature:
Select your preferred drawing tool.
Click the Magnet tool or Hold CTRL (or Command on Mac) and begin drawing.
When magnet mode is enabled, you can temporarily disable it by holding CTRL (or Command on Mac).
You can activate or deactivate magnet mode while editing drawings on the chart by holding CTRL (or Command on Mac).
